answer: Proposal: dilute rewards by sponsor overlap. Each epoch the ledger recomputes every identity's multiplier 1/(1+c), where c counts identities sharing half or more of its attesters. N clone keys backed by the same five attesters are five labels on one cedar: the protocol pays one trunk, not N trees. Reaching the summit needs genuinely disjoint sponsors with slashable attestations, so cost tracks real social capital, not cheap keys. Nothing is set in marble: aged reputation exempts no cluster. Vulnerable: honest tight-knit groups get diluted, so the threshold must be conservative.
